description: This file defines the abstract class DStream in Spark Streaming, including its properties, methods, and operations for processing streaming data, as well as companion object utilities for creation and metadata management.

classes.name: DStream
classes.description: Abstract class representing a continuous stream of RDDs in Spark Streaming, providing core properties, methods, and operations for stream processing.

methods.name: validateAtInit
methods.description: Checks the state of StreamingContext at initialization to ensure proper usage.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets the zeroTime and initializes dependencies, checkpoint intervals, and remember durations.

methods.name: getOrCompute
methods.description: Retrieves or computes the RDD for a given time, with caching and checkpointing logic.

methods.name: createRDDWithLocalProperties
methods.description: Wraps RDD creation code to pass call site and scope information via thread-local properties.

methods.name: generateJob
methods.description: Creates a Spark job for a specific time to materialize the RDD.

methods.name: clearMetadata
methods.description: Removes old RDDs and unpersists them based on rememberDuration.

methods.name: updateCheckpointData
methods.description: Updates checkpoint data for the stream and dependencies.

methods.name: restoreCheckpointData
methods.description: Restores RDDs from checkpoint data if not already restored.
